summary_1line: Ravana’s son Aksha confronts Hanuman in a fierce aerial battle, but Hanuman ultimately destroys his chariot and prepares to kill the young warrior.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prince Aksha rides a golden chariot drawn by eight swift horses through the sky toward Hanuman standing at the city gate.
Hanuman, bleeding from three arrows in his forehead, glows like a rising sun as he roars in the sky.
Hanuman leaps into the air and smashes Aksha’s flying chariot with his palm, sending the shattered vehicle and dead horses crashing from the sky.
